Independent temperature-controlled fan system proposal | Biswajit Jana Proposal: Independent Temperature-Controlled Fan System Local thermal stabilisation around the camera / heat-sink assembly 1. Aim I propose adding a small independent fan-control system around the camera / heat-sink region to reduce local thermal excursions without running the fans at maximum speed continuously. The controller would be separate from the LK220 and from the camera TEC. Its only purpose would be to respond to the local surface temperature and provide additional airflow when required. 2. Proposed operating principle The first version would use a simple two-level control strategy rather than a full PID loop. Under normal thermal conditions the two 5 V fans would operate at approximately 50% command. If the measured local temperature rises above a defined high-temperature threshold, both fans would switch to 100%. Once the temperature falls below a lower return threshold, the fans would return to the normal reduced-speed state. This creates a small hysteresis band so that the controller does not rapidly switch between the two states. The final temperature thresholds would be selected from measured operating data rather than assuming that the correct camera-body temperature is exactly the LK220 coolant setpoint. 3.
